SELECT id, original_url, send_target_id, is_clicked, clicked_at, is_converted, purpose,
FROM short_url WHERE id = #{id} AND NVL(is_deleted, 0) = 0

SELECT su.id AS short_url_id, su.original_url, su.purpose, su.send_target_id, st.send_history_id, st.customer_id, st.user_uuid, st.final_channel_id AS channel_id, ch.channel_type, c.name AS customer_name, c.phone FROM short_url su JOIN send_target st ON st.id = su.send_target_id AND NVL(st.is_deleted, 0) = 0 JOIN customer c ON c.id = st.customer_id AND NVL(c.is_deleted, 0) = 0 LEFT JOIN channel ch ON ch.id = st.final_channel_id AND NVL(ch.is_deleted, 0) = 0 WHERE su.id = #{id} AND NVL(su.is_deleted, 0) = 0

SELECT st.id AS send_target_id, st.send_history_id, st.customer_id, st.user_uuid, st.final_channel_id AS channel_id, ch.channel_type, c.name AS customer_name, c.phone FROM send_target st JOIN customer c ON c.id = st.customer_id AND NVL(c.is_deleted, 0) = 0 LEFT JOIN channel ch ON ch.id = st.final_channel_id AND NVL(ch.is_deleted, 0) = 0 WHERE st.id = #{sendTargetId} AND NVL(st.is_deleted, 0) = 0
